slides.title: How do you study one week before finals?
slides.subtitle: Stop rereading your summaries.

slides.headline: Turn them into
slides.body: We don't like making mistakes, and that's exactly why testing yourself works.
slides.kicker: You try to answer, you get it wrong, you check, and your brain holds on to it.

slides.headline: It's called
slides.body: Tonight: take one chapter and write 10 question-and-answer flashcards. Tomorrow, quiz yourself before you look.
slides.kicker: Free apps like Space and Anki Universal space the practice for you.

slides.quote: Getting it wrong this week is the point.
